name: covenant-public
description: Find services, draft work terms and review changes through four public Covenant tools.

interface.longDescription: For a small job, find published service adverts and draft the deliverable, price, deadline and delivery review. Compare revisions before anyone approves. Make a readable copy of the exact draft, then check what the supplied approvals and evidence establish or leave unknown. These nine public tools need no account. Drafts remain unsigned: this plugin does not sign, publish adverts, create private account records, place an order or move money. Search results can include labelled demos; confirm real availability with the supplier. Supplied records are checked only within the stated verification scope. The hosted service is a developer pilot. Private account features and the separately licensed engine are outside this plugin.
capabilities: Draft a job, price and deadline
defaultPrompt: Find published research services and label any demos. Tell me if there is no matching supplier.
Draft a one-page research brief for USD 25, due Friday, with buyer review. Keep it unsigned.
Compare these two drafts: show the price and deadline changes and what needs fresh approval.

review.commerce_description: Public service-advert discovery and unsigned proposal preparation only. This plugin does not perform checkout, create orders with assent, collect fees, execute payments or provide financial trading. Paid account features are excluded.

positive.prompt: What can Covenant do here? Find the free actions and explain which actions need a separate account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public routes and explain when a scoped account grant is needed. Keep signing keys with the owner.

positive.prompt: Find public research services. Show test listings separately and say if there are no available matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the actual matched links and distinguish a test advert from a real provider. An empty result is valid. Do not claim availability.

positive.prompt: Draft a USD 25 research brief for the sample buyer and supplier, due in three days, with buyer review. Keep it unsigned.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the action schema then return the exact USD 25 draft and identifier. The draft is unsigned and authorizes nothing.

positive.prompt: Compare the two sample research terms. Show the USD 25 to USD 30 price change and tell me what needs fresh approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the old and new identifiers, the price change and the need for fresh approval.

positive.description: Check a record with no supplied proofs
positive.prompt: Check the sample case with no attached proofs. Tell me what is verified and what still needs proof.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain that no proofs were supplied or verified. Do not use the all-supplied Boolean to claim verification.

negative.description: Reject a draft passed as a review case
negative.prompt: Try reviewing the supplied unsigned draft wrapper as a coordination case. It must not count as a verified agreement.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the exact coordination case or report a precise case format error.

negative.prompt: Review the supplied sample coordination case against the different expected case identifier. Keep the mismatch visible.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the correct case or expected identifier. Do not adopt a different exact record.

negative.prompt: Check the supplied sample record claiming a role with a malformed public key. Tell me which authority was established.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for a correctly formatted public key or report the identity format error. Do not infer authority or approval.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0 points to the Covenant engine and its four current public entry tools. The reviewer cases use public search, unsigned drafting, revisions and supplied-record checks.
